|---|---|---|---|
| Truck | 2010s American full-size pre-runner pickup, 6.2 L naturally aspirated V8, RWD, 6-speed automatic, long-travel coilover-and-bypass suspension, widened fenders, 35-inch all-terrain tires | 5 / 5 | 32,000 |

## Design note

Built to fly across the desert at 150 km/h, it treats a city as a set of jumps. A foot of suspension travel soaks up kerbs, medians and staircases that would break any other car, and the V8 and locker push it through dirt lots and parks where the supercars cannot follow. On tarmac it rolls like a ship, the tall all-terrains give up early and it takes a long time to stop.

## How this car breaks

Fully boxed ladder frame with steel tube bumpers front and rear: it bulldozes traffic and barely notices. The long-travel front end is its soft spot — the wide wishbones and bypass shocks stick out past the body, so offset hits fold a front corner. The bed and composite fender flares crumple and shed cheaply.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2010s full-size off-road performance pickups
- owner dyno averages for 6.2 L SOHC truck V8s
- off-road builder data for long-travel suspension kits (travel, spring rates, bypass damping)
- engineering tables (tire radius, ride frequency, twin-piston caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 2013 | 0.95 | 1910 |
| pitch | 8885 | 0.97 | 8620 |
| yaw | 9077 | 0.97 | 8810 |

## Engine

6.2 L SOHC 16-valve V8, naturally aspirated, two-valve heads, high-flow intake and exhaust. Class-typical 2010s 6.2 L truck V8 (~51 kW/L, ~317 kW at 6000 rpm, 588 N·m at 4000) per manufacturer spec-class data and owner dyno averages; big displacement, flat torque, heavy rotating assembly.

Peak **317 kW @ 6000 rpm**, **588 N·m @ 4000 rpm**. Idle 650 / redline 6000 / limiter 6250 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.24 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 10% of peak torque = 59 N·m. Power-to-weight 115 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed automatic with torque converter, electronic locking rear differential modelled as a stiff clutch LSD. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: clutch LSD, preload 80 N·m, power ramp 0.50, coast ramp 0.30. Torque converter: stall 2300 rpm, 2.0× at stall, couples 1:1 from 2700 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.60 × peak torque = 940 N·m. Shift time 0.35 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4.17 | 17.10 | 55 |
| 2 | 2.34 | 9.59 | 99 |
| 3 | 1.52 | 6.23 | 152 |
| 4 | 1.14 | 4.67 | 203 |
| 5 | 0.87 | 3.57 | 266 |
| 6 | 0.69 | 2.83 | 335 |

Final drive 4.10, reverse 3.40. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.419 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.35 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 717 kg | 1.15 Hz | 37500 N/m | 3630 N·s/m | 5440 N·s/m | 0.33 m |
| Rear | 542 kg | 1.35 Hz | 39000 N/m | 3220 N·s/m | 4830 N·s/m | 0.35 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 6.0°/g with 55% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.702 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 181509 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 64789 F / 67440 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **10100 F / 4100 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 6.0°/g, front share 55%. Bump stops 120000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 5.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 345 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm + 54 mm → A = 45.8 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 148 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·45.8 cm²·0.147 m = **5405 N·m**
- Rear: 336 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm → A = 22.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 143 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·22.9 cm²·0.143 m = **2489 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 4397 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.23×), rear needs 1272 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.96×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 1562 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.615** → delivered 5400 N·m front / 1559 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 3740 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 17.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 14.5 m → outer-front path radius 7.09 m, rear-axle-centre radius 5.11 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.628 rad (36.0°)** (outer 31.5°, inner 41.6° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.80). Rack speed 1.3 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/mesquite_pr.json`)

303 nodes, 1857 beams, 6 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id mesquite_pr --profile truck --width 2.19 --length 5.89 --height 1.99 --wheelbase 3.71 --mass 606.9 --car-mass 2758.5 --clearance 0.29 --front-overhang 0.98 --strength 1.3` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 5).
- Era `2010s`: gen-lattice's default HSS passenger cell kept as is.
- Chrome steel bumpers: 180 bumper beams pp_bumper → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Body-on-frame: 16 cab-floor rail nodes relabelled FrameLeft/FrameRight; 14 under-cab rail beams → hss 4.36e-04 m² so the ladder frame runs bumper to bumper.
- Side-saddle fuel tank outboard of the left frame rail between cab and rear axle.
